item.tib: 'phags pa rtsa ba'i mdzod sman chen po'i rim pa
item.coloph: 'phags pa rtsa ba'i mdzod sman chen po'i rim pa slob dpon dpal ldan 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so
item.colophTitle: 'phags pa rtsa ba'i mdzod sman chen po'i rim pa

translator.name: slob dpon dpal ldan 'phags pa klu sgrub
zha lu lo tsā ba ge slong chos skyong bzang po

item.tib: 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i man ngag zab mo
item.coloph: 'di ni byams pa gling gi gzims khang du rgya dpe bzhugs pa las chos rje rin po che ngag gi dbang phyug bsod nams rnam rgyal dpal bzang po'i bka' bzhin du/ zha lu lo tsA ba dge slong chos skyong bzang pos rgya dpe bzhin ji ltar go ba rnams bsgyur ba'o
